title: Pads
description: Set up your Launchpad: what each pad does, its colour and its pages.
resetBody: Every page and pad goes back to the defaults. Your changes are lost.

status.busy: Busy: in use by another app

board.hint: Live view of the device. Click a button to edit it.

howto.title: How it works
howto.pages: The round buttons on the right switch pages (up to 7). Click one here to edit that page.
howto.map: The last round button (Arm) shows what every pad does. Hold it to peek, tap it to keep the map open.
howto.hold: Give a pad a long-press action and holding it runs that instead.
howto.presets: Pick a pad, start from a preset (Claude Code, a website, a shortcut…) and adjust it.

pad.testHint: Run this pad now, as if you pressed it
pad.label: Label
pad.labelHint: Shown on the pad map and in the HUD.
pad.colorHint: The Launchpad S only has red and green LEDs. The dot shows how it will look.
pad.holdHint: Runs when you hold the pad for half a second. Leave it on Nothing to ignore long presses.

action.argsHint: Optional. Use quotes for values with spaces.
action.commandHint: Runs in Windows Terminal, e.g. claude or codex.
action.claudeHint: Brings Claude Code to the front. If it isn't running, starts it in this folder.
action.processHint: Window to bring to the front, e.g. chrome.exe.
action.fallbackHint: Optional. A program path, shell:AppsFolder\<AppID> or a URL.
action.appKeysHint: Brings the app to the front, presses the keys, then goes back.
action.volumeHint: A process name, or master for the whole PC.
action.noProfiles: No lighting profiles yet. Create one in Lighting.
action.micHint: Toggles the microphone, same as the mic hotkey in Integrations.
action.mapHint: Shows or hides the on-screen pad map.

hints.none: The pad always shows its colour.
hints.claude: Pulses green while Claude works, blinks orange when it waits for you.
hints.mic: Red while muted, green while live.
hints.notification: Blinks while a notification from this rule is waiting. Rules live in Integrations → Notifications.
hints.running: Full brightness while the app runs, dim otherwise.

page.noneHint: This round button has no page yet. Pages fill the right column from the top.
page.name: Name

kindHint.grid: Every pad runs its own action.
kindHint.mixer: Each column is one app's volume. The top buttons mute it.
kindHint.agents: Each pad is a live Claude Code or Codex session. Tap an empty pad for Claude, double-tap it for Codex.
kindHint.windows: Each pad is an open window in its app's colour (Chrome red, Terminal green, Cursor amber, Explorer yellow); the one in front is brightest and a window with tabs breathes. Tap: front / minimise, hold: its tabs.
kindHint.tasks: A checklist: each pad is a task. Tap marks it done, hold edits it, an empty pad asks for a new one. The list shows on screen while you are on this page.
kindHint.app: The shortcuts of the app you are working in (Obsidian, DaVinci Resolve, Photoshop…), from your shortcut packs. Each pad is one shortcut in its category's colour; the top buttons show one category at a time.

page.appsHint: While one of these apps is in front. Process names, * matches anything.
page.deleteBody: The page and all its pads are removed.

mapButton.title: Pad map
mapButton.body: This button shows an on-screen map of the current page. Hold it to peek, tap it to keep the map open, tap again to close it.

mixer.body: Tap a pad to set that column's volume. The round button on top mutes it.
mixer.columnsHint: A process name, master for the whole PC, or empty to take the next app playing audio.
mixer.pickHint: Click an app to put it in column {n}.
mixer.noAudio: No app is playing audio right now.

settings.title: Device
settings.portHint: Leave empty to use the first Launchpad found.
settings.mapHotkeyHint: Shows or hides the pad map from anywhere.
settings.releaseFor: Let go of the Launchpad while these apps run
settings.releaseForHint: Windows lets only one app use a MIDI port, so music apps like Ableton need it free. * matches anything.
settings.hud: Show the pad name in the HUD
settings.hudHint: Handy while you learn the layout.

agents.sessionHint: On the Launchpad: tap to jump to its window and see what it needs. Once there, tap again to dictate, once more to stop (double tap: stop and send), or hold it to dictate while held (KeyHalo holds Space for Claude Code's voice mode; turn it on with /voice). It stops if you leave the window. In Cursor or VS Code, click the terminal first.
agents.emptyHint: On the Launchpad: tap once to open Claude Code here, twice for Codex. It opens in the folder of the File Explorer window in front, or in the default folder below. ▲ and ▼ on top do the same in the next free pad.
agents.folderHint: Used when no File Explorer window is in front. Empty = your user folder.
agents.connections: So pads know when an agent needs you
agents.outdated: Connected by an older version: KeyHalo updates it on its own.
agents.claudeHint: Adds KeyHalo's hooks to Claude Code (your other settings stay).
agents.codexHint: Sets KeyHalo as Codex's notify command in ~/.codex/config.toml.
agents.codexOther: Codex already runs another program on notify; KeyHalo leaves it alone.
agents.apiOff: Turn on the local API (Settings) so agents can reach KeyHalo.
agents.dictateClick: Click its terminal, then press the pad again to dictate
agents.dictateTap: Dictating · tap: stop · double tap: stop and send
agents.dictateLeft: Dictation stopped: you left the window
agents.resumeWhere: Now tap the pad to open it on
agents.resumeHintPages: Tap its pad (top row)  ·  ▲ ▼ more sessions  ·  ◀ cancels
agents.closeHint: Hold Close and tap a session to close it
agents.closeFailed: Couldn't close it: close its terminal by hand

windows.emptyHint: New windows take the free pads. Each window keeps its pad while it is open.
windows.hint: On the Launchpad: tap to bring it to the front (tap again to minimise). Hold it to see its tabs on the pads (Chrome, Edge, Terminal…) and jump between them.

toolHints.tile: Puts the open windows (up to 9) in a grid on the screen in front.
toolHints.desktop: Shows the desktop (Win+D); again to bring everything back.
toolHints.left: Snaps the window in front to the left half (Win+Left).
toolHints.right: Snaps the window in front to the right half (Win+Right).
toolHints.close: Tap: closes the tab in front (Ctrl+W). Hold it and tap window pads: closes those windows (the pads blink red).

windows.tabsHint: Tap a pad: go to that tab  ·  ▲ ▼ previous / next  ·  ◀ back to the windows

tasks.mapHint: Tap: done / to do  ·  Hold: edit  ·  Empty pad: new task
tasks.mapEmpty: Tap any pad to write your first task
tasks.emptyHint: On the Launchpad, tap this pad to write a task in it (a small box opens; Enter saves).
tasks.hint: On the Launchpad: tap to mark it done (or to do again), hold to edit it.

hub.missing: BrokenWatchHub isn't installed on this PC
hub.keyOff: Broken's key is off in the Puente (Panel › Ajustes)
hub.captureHint: Enter ✓  ·  Esc ✕  ·  HILO reads the date from the text
hub.mapHint: Tap: done (tap again to undo)  ·  Hold: details  ·  Empty pad: new  ·  Broken: dictate
hub.mapEmpty: No to-dos in HILO. Tap a pad to write one, or hold Broken and dictate it
hub.sourceHint: HILO: the same to-dos as on your glasses and with Broken. Only this page: a list kept in KeyHalo.
hub.notInstalled: BrokenWatchHub isn't installed (or its Puente has no token yet).

app.title: App
app.waiting: Switch to an app to see its shortcuts
app.none: No shortcut pack for {app} yet (Keymaps › add one)
app.hint: Tap a pad: press that shortcut in the app  ·  Top buttons: one category
app.noneHint: Make one in Keymaps (or get one from Community): every pack with the app's .exe shows up here.
